who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane in-process host (audit 2026-11-13 step 2)
task: Serve a command in its own process with no daemon, and measure it against a daemon
do: Put `[serve]\nhost = "process"` in `$BLAZE_HOME/config.toml` (typed: `blaze_thin::host::Host`, read once by the thin client and by `cli::daemon::host`; "daemon" is the default). A certificate hit still answers in the thin client; a miss execs the engine, which runs `serve::once` (the daemon's engine on this thread, one in-process connection), stops and flushes, waits for the history's last flush and exits dropping nothing. A daemon already running for that home is refused by name (`blaze stop` first). Shared repro cases (`Case::new` in crates/blaze-engine/tests/repro.rs) follow the test process's own `[serve] host`; `Case::own` cases always use a daemon. Measure both side by side with `blaze run -q -p scripts --bin in_process -- '{"project": "<dir>", "blaze": "<blaze>", "timeout_s": 1800, "edit": {"file": "<file>", "find": "<text once>", "replace": ["<other>"]}, "floor_ms": {"body": 50}, "work": "<dir not /tmp>"}'` (fields: its DOC, or `selftest`).
why: The audit's verdict (b) asks what no daemon costs; the mode and the script are where that number comes from, and neither is in a doc.
